normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

statuses.accepted: The normalized COL name resolves to exactly one valid ITIS Mammalia species and directly equals that current ITIS name.
statuses.synonym-current-name-redirect: The normalized COL name equals one or more official ITIS invalid species names whose synonym_links rows resolve to exactly one valid ITIS Mammalia species.
statuses.ambiguous: The normalized exact evidence resolves to more than one valid ITIS Mammalia species TSN.
statuses.unmatched: No normalized exact valid-name or official species-synonym evidence resolves to a valid ITIS Mammalia species.
statuses.forbidden: No fuzzy, edit-distance, phonetic, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, token-reordered, genus-substitution or higher-rank match is permitted.

evidenceBoundary.en: This CC0 ITIS sidecar supplies release-pinned TSNs and exact nomenclatural redirects. It is not an MDD equivalent, a final classification authority, a phylogeny, or evidence that COL and ITIS use the same species concept.
evidenceBoundary.zh: 此 CC0 ITIS 侧车仅提供固定版本的 TSN 与严格同名重定向；它不是 MDD 的等价替代品，也不是最终分类权威、系统发育树，且不表示 COL 与 ITIS 采用相同物种概念。
